headline: Indonesia and Canada enforce CEPA starting December 1, 2026
summary: Indonesia and Canada will begin enforcing their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement on December 1, 2026. The agreement is a comprehensive bilateral economic partnership between the two countries.
why: Trade agreements reduce tariffs and barriers between countries, affecting export opportunities and supply chains for companies trading between the two economies.
